segments.he: עוֹד עֵצָה לָזֶה, שֶׁיְּשַׂמַּח אֶת עַצְמוֹ וְיָגִיל וְיָשִׂישׂ בִּנְקֻדָּתוֹ הַטּוֹבָה בַּמֶּה שֶּׁזָּכָה לִהְיוֹת מִזֶּרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וּלְהִתְקָרֵב לְאַנְשֵׁי אֱמֶת הַמּוֹלִיכִין וּמַדְרִיכִין אוֹתוֹ בְּדֶרֶךְ הָאֱמֶת, אֲשֶׁר עַל יְדֵי זֶה אֵיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה יֵשׁ לוֹ תִּקְוָה טוֹבָה לָנֶצַח וְעַל יְדֵי הַשִּׂמְחָה הַזּאת הוּא מְשַׁבֵּר הַקְּלִפּוֹת שֶׁהֵם הַמְּנִיעוֹת וְכוּ שֶׁבְּכָל דַּרְגָּא (שָׁם)
segments.en: The main strengthening of oneself, and proficiency in this halachah (lit. going forward, fig. Jewish law) of teshuvah, the main thing is through complete emunah that God is one, the first and the last, and his rulership is in every place. And everything a person goes through, and which the entire world goes through—light and darkness; night and day; destruction and construction—one should connect everything to Hashem Yisborach. And this is an aspect of the connection between the lower point and the higher point. And in this way he will merit that not a single day of the days of his life will be lost. And every day he will merit to find what had been lost, which belongs to the root of his soul. (Likutei Halachos, Birkas HaPayrot 5:15)
